Dragon Tales and Gundam Voice Actress Chantal Strand Turns 39! 🎙️🎉

Strand has been a familiar voice across Western animation and English-dubbed anime since childhood, with standout roles including Cassie in Dragon Tales, Lacus Clyne and Meer Campbell in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, Bijou in Hamtaro, and Diamond Tiara in My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic. Her work also spans X-Men: Evolution, Inuyasha, Gundam 00, Barbie, and Tom and Jerry.

Some of her most notable voice roles include:
• Cassie (Dragon Tales)
• Diamond Tiara / Spoiled Rich (My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic)
• Lacus Clyne (Mobile Suit Gundam SEED / SEED Destiny)
• Bijou (Hamtaro)
• Gemini “Gem” Stone (Sabrina: The Animated Series)
• Rahne Sinclair / Wolfsbane (X-Men: Evolution)
• Feldt Grace (Mobile Suit Gundam 00 / A Wakening of the Trailblazer)
• Tama (Gintama°)
• Kelly (Barbie in the Nutcracker / Barbie as Rapunzel / Barbie of Swan Lake)
• Meer Campbell (Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny)
• Tuffy / Nibbles (Tom and Jerry Tales / Tom and Jerry: A Nutcracker Tale)
• Madeline (My Fair Madeline)
• Kazumi Yoshida (Shakugan no Shana)
• Akari Fujisaki (Hikaru no Go)
• Mayu Ikeda / Asuka (Inuyasha)
• Princess Lacey (Barbie in the 12 Dancing Princesses)
• Molly O! (Generation O!)
• Valerie Velociraptor (Dinosaur Train)
• Melody (Dragalia Lost)
• Tammy (Air Bud Films)

That mix of childhood animation, anime dubbing, family films, and long-running franchises gives Strand a résumé that stretches across several generations of viewers.

Happy 39th birthday, Chantal Strand! From Cassie and Bijou to Lacus Clyne and Diamond Tiara, her characters remain instantly familiar to fans who grew up with them. 🎂🎙️✨
